title: Dynamic Relational Priming Improves Transformer in Multivariate Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2509.12196v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Standard attention mechanisms in transformers employ static token representations that remain unchanged across all pair-wise computations in each layer. This limits their representational alignment with the potentially diverse relational dynamics of each token-pair interaction. While they excel in domains with relatively homogeneous relationships, standard attention's static relational learning struggles to capture the diverse, heterogeneous inter-channel dependencies of multivariate time series (MTS) data--where different channel-pair interactions within a single system may be governed by entirely different physical laws or temporal dynamics. To better align the attention mechanism for such domain phenomena, we propose attention with dynamic relational priming (prime attention). translated_title: 动态关系启动机制改进多元时间序列中的Transformer
translated_abstract: 标准Transformer中的注意力机制采用静态的token表示，这些表示在每一层的所有成对计算中保持不变。这限制了其表征与每个token对交互中潜在多样关系动态之间的对齐。尽管标准注意力在关系相对同质的领域表现出色，但其静态关系学习难以捕捉多元时间序列（MTS）数据中多样且异构的通道间依赖关系——在多元时间序列中，同一系统内不同的通道对交互可能由完全不同的物理定律或时间动态所支配。为了使注意力机制更好地与这类领域现象对齐，我们提出了带动态关系启动的注意力机制（prime attention）。与标准注意力中每个token在所有成对交互中呈现相同表示不同，prime attention会为每个（token对交互）定制表示。
tldr: 本文提出动态关系启动注意力机制（prime attention），通过为每个token对交互定制动态表示，显著改进了Transformer在多元时间序列建模中捕捉异构通道间依赖关系的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes prime attention with dynamic relational priming, which tailors token representations for each pair-wise interaction to improve Transformer's ability to capture heterogeneous inter-channel dependencies in multivariate time series.
